question: Which of the following is one of the criteria for the inclusion of drugs in the selective financing of the National Health System ?:

options.opa: Therapeutic and social value of the medicine.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Therapeutic and social value of the medicine" -> "consideration for selective financing" -> 80% CHAIN: "Low price" -> "may be a factor in selective financing decisions" -> 70% CHAIN: "Security" -> "important for drug approval but not the sole criterion for selective financing" -> 60% CHAIN: "Effectiveness" -> "critical for inclusion in selective financing due to cost-effectiveness considerations" -> 80%
analysis: Inclusion of drugs in the selective financing of the National Health System is based on various criteria, including therapeutic and social value, safety, and effectiveness of the medicine.
